title: Suricata — SIEM Security Operations
description: Analyst-workflow SIEM dashboard: SOC command center, kill-chain lifecycle, attacker/target correlation, geographic intelligence, application-layer hunting, anomaly detection and priority alert feed.

panels.title: Total Alerts
panels.description: All Suricata alert events in the selected time range

panels.title: Current Rate (ev/min)
panels.description: Alert events per minute — rolling 5-minute average

panels.title: High Severity Alerts (Sev 1)
panels.description: Highest-confidence, highest-priority alert events

panels.title: Unique Attackers
panels.description: Distinct source IP addresses that triggered alert rules

panels.title: Unique Targets
panels.description: Distinct destination IP addresses receiving attack traffic

panels.title: Countries Observed
panels.description: Distinct countries of origin seen in alert traffic (GeoIP on dest_ip)

panels.title: Alert Rate by Kill Chain Phase
panels.description: Mapped from Emerging Threats signature prefixes: ET SCAN=Recon | ET EXPLOIT=Exploitation | ET TROJAN/MALWARE=C2 | ET DOS=DoS | ET INFO=Intelligence

targets.expr: sum(rate({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_signature =~ "(ET TROJAN|ET MALWARE).*" [$__interval]))
sum(count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_signature =~ "(ET TROJAN|ET MALWARE).*" [$__range]))

panels.title: Top Attacking Source IPs
panels.description: Click a source IP to look it up on AbuseIPDB threat intelligence

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | src_ip != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top Targeted Destinations
panels.description: Internal assets receiving the most alert-triggering traffic

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (dest_ip, dest_port) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | dest_ip != "" | dest_port != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Attacker → Target Correlation
panels.description: Direct src→dest mapping — pivot point for incident investigation and lateral movement detection

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (src_ip, dest_ip) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | src_ip != "" | dest_ip != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Alert Origin World Map (GeoIP on dest_ip)
panels.description: Countries of external IPs observed in alert traffic, enriched via GeoIP

panels.title: Top 20 Alert Signatures
panels.description: Ranked by hit count — highest entries are the most active attack patterns in your network

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (alert_signature) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_signature != "" [$__range])))
topk(15, sum by (alert_category) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_category != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top DNS Queries
panels.description: High-frequency DNS lookups — watch for C2 beaconing, DGA domains, data exfiltration via DNS

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (dns_rrname) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="dns"} | json | dns_rrname != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top HTTP Hostnames
panels.description: Most-accessed HTTP hostnames — investigate unexpected external destinations

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (http_hostname) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="http"} | json | http_hostname != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top TLS SNI Destinations
panels.description: Encrypted channel destinations — watch for unknown/suspicious SNI names indicating C2 over TLS

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (tls_sni) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="tls"} | json | tls_sni != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: HTTP Methods
panels.description: Unusual spikes in PUT/DELETE/OPTIONS may indicate web API abuse or exploitation attempts

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="http"} | json | http_method != "GET" | http_method != "POST" | http_method != "PUT" | http_method != "DELETE" | http_method != "" [$__range]))

panels.title: Anomaly Event Rate
panels.description: Protocol and traffic anomalies detected by Suricata — spikes often precede or accompany active exploitation

panels.title: Top Anomaly Event Types
panels.description: Most frequent protocol anomalies — high counts of TCP stream issues may indicate active scanning or evasion

targets.expr: topk(12, sum by (anomaly_type) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="anomaly"} | json | anomaly_type != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Severity 1 Alerts — Immediate Investigation Required
panels.description: Only the highest-priority alerts shown here. Every entry in this feed warrants analyst attention.

panels.title: iprep Hits Total
panels.description: All alerts matching IP reputation rules (SIDs 9000001–9000011)

panels.title: Botnet C2 Hits
panels.description: Traffic to/from Feodo-tracked botnet C2 servers (SIDs 9000001–9000003)

panels.title: Malware Host Hits
panels.description: Traffic to/from known malware distribution or C2 hosts (SIDs 9000004–9000007)

panels.title: Scanner / Brute Force Hits
panels.description: Inbound from known scanners on CINS Bad Guys list (SID 9000008)

panels.title: Phishing / Spam Hits
panels.description: Traffic to phishing sites or spam-listed hosts (SIDs 9000009–9000011)

panels.title: High-Confidence Hits (P1)
panels.description: iprep alerts at priority 1 — Feodo C2 (score>90) or URLhaus/abuse.ch malware (score>84)

panels.title: iprep Alert Rate by Threat Category
panels.description: Alert rate over time broken down by threat category from iprep rules

panels.title: iprep Hits by Rule
panels.description: Which iprep rules fired and how many times, sorted by hit count

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (alert_signature) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_signature =~ "IPREP.*" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top Source IPs — iprep Matches
panels.description: Source IPs most frequently seen triggering iprep alert rules

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (src_ip) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | src_ip != "" | alert_signature =~ "IPREP.*" [$__range])))

panels.title: iprep Alert Log — Recent IP Reputation Hits
panels.description: Live log of Suricata alerts matching iprep reputation rules

panels.title: 🔐  TLS & SSH FINGERPRINTING
panels.description: JA3/JA4 TLS client fingerprints and HASSH SSH fingerprints — enabled 2026-02-28. Use for C2 detection, tool identification and threat hunting.

panels.title: Top JA4 TLS Fingerprints
panels.description: JA4 client fingerprints (more robust than JA3) — identify TLS implementations, malware C2 frameworks, scanners. Cross-reference with ja4db.com.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (tls_ja4) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="tls"} | json | tls_ja4 != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top JA3 TLS Fingerprints
panels.description: JA3 client fingerprints — broad malware/tool identification. Cross-reference with threat-intel databases.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (tls_ja3_hash) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="tls"} | json | tls_ja3_hash != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top HASSH SSH Client Fingerprints
panels.description: SSH client HASSH hashes — fingerprints SSH implementations. Known bad: Metasploit (ec7378c1a92f5a8dde7e8b7a1ddf33d1), Paramiko, Cobalt Strike.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ssh_client_hassh_hash) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="ssh"} | json | ssh_client_hassh_hash != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: TLS Session Resumption Rate
panels.description: Session resumptions/min — sustained high rate on same JA3/JA4 fingerprint is a strong C2 beacon indicator. Enabled 2026-02-28.

panels.title: TLS Session Resumptions
panels.description: Total TLS sessions resumed (ticket reuse). High count relative to new sessions can indicate persistent C2 beaconing.

panels.title: TLS No-SNI Connections
panels.description: TLS connections with no Server Name Indication (SNI). May indicate malware, misconfigured app, or DNS-less C2 beaconing.

panels.title: TLS No-SNI — Top Destinations
panels.description: IPs contacted over TLS without SNI. Prioritise unknown/external IPs for investigation.

targets.expr: topk(8, sum by (dest_ip) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="tls"} | json | tls_sni="" | dest_ip != "" [$__range])))

panels.title: 📡  APP-ID & PROTOCOL HUNTING
panels.description: Application protocol identification via oisf/trafficid (58 rules, added 2026-02-28) and HTTP body payload capture.

panels.title: App-ID Protocol Distribution (oisf/trafficid)
panels.description: Protocol breakdown identified by traffic-pattern rules — shows what application protocols are present on your network, even without port correlation.

panels.title: App-ID Rules Fired — Ranked
panels.description: Application identification rules that fired, ranked by hit count. Useful for protocol baseline and anomaly detection (e.g. unexpected BitTorrent or IRC).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (alert_signature) (count_over_time({job="suricata", event_type="alert"} | json | alert_signature =~ ".*TRAFFIC.ID.*" [$__range])))

panels.title: HTTP Alerts — Payload Preview
panels.description: Alert events on HTTP traffic. HTTP body capture enabled 2026-02-28 (4KB cap, base64+printable). Look for http_http_request_body_printable in log details.
